title: Nash Nest at Golf Retreat
description:
Kick back & relax in this modern condo.Sits on golf course with a beautiful view. Safe gated community. Convenient to airport, Priest Lake and many local venues. 10 miles to Broadway, inexpensive Uber ride. Beautiful open kitchen to accommodate your cooking & baking needs.Large open living room with sectional sofa, 55” flat screen smart TV. Lighted deck overlooking the 12th green has a wood burning chiminea, charcoal grill, pub table/chairs, and a cushioned loveseat to make for relaxing nights.

The space
This is a Double master condo, therefore each bedroom has its own private bathroom.
Windows should remain closed and locked. 
Please do not relocate any furnishings or decorations.
